prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished 16:9 pixel-art room background for a 640x360 Phaser multiplayer game. Input images: first image is ONLY the pixel rendering style and camera reference from the existing dance studio; second and third images are the requested KTV room interior reference. Generate a new EMPTY KTV private room, with no people, matching the precise straight-on slightly elevated room perspective and fine crisp pixel art of the first reference. Preserve from the KTV photos: dark charcoal ceiling with recessed lights, a small hanging disco ball, amber/purple LED strips, black tufted wraparound leather sofa, low polished black rectangular coffee table, black and white angular maze-pattern floor, copper accents and a sports car wall mural (no brand emblem).
Composition MUST fit these coordinates relative to a 640x360 canvas: rear wall extends from y=0 to y=150; open walking floor from y=160 to bottom. Black tufted sofa along rear-left, x=40..340 and y=132..188; side sofa runs down left wall x=35..100, y=178..285. One long low black table at x=125..320,y=228..265 with a tissue box, fruit plate and a couple of glasses, no oversized objects. Large perfectly frontal rectangular karaoke screen on rear-right wall at x=382..568,y=48..130 with a plain very dark teal EMPTY screen, no baked-in letters. Speakers next to screen. Small point-song touchscreen station in right area around x=550,y=166..216. One slim microphone on a stand at x=429,y=182..250. Copper door at far right near x=603,y=215..316, exit clear. Tiny round stools near the table. Plenty of empty walking space between furniture and along bottom. Warm amber wall with circular automotive-inspired pattern behind sofa, violet and teal light accents. Clear readable furniture despite dim ambient mood. Scene fills whole image edge to edge without border. Output 16:9 landscape. No people, no character sprites, no logos, no watermarks, no captions, no UI overlays, no unreadable labels.

Final edit prompt:
Edit this pixel-art KTV room background for a walkable game. Preserve all room walls, ceiling, disco ball, lighting, sofa, microphone, touchscreen, door, screen, pixel rendering style and framing EXACTLY. Change ONLY the coffee table and its three stools: translate the table and all three stools DOWN on the image by about 15 percent of the full image height (equivalent to 54 pixels on a 640x360 scene), keeping their sizes and perspective unchanged. This must create a clearly visible walking aisle of patterned floor between the rear sofa and back edge of the table, at least 25 pixels wide on a 640x360 canvas. Table target at x115..300 y224..280; stools in front at y270..300. Do not add people or any other objects. No text, no watermarks. Keep the image 16:9.
